mastering: mono 44.1 kHz 16-bit; leading silence trimmed at -45 dB; peak -3 dBFS; 3 ms attack / 25 ms release; multi-event clips sliced at their strongest onsets

request.prompt: Instrumental game soundtrack loop for a 2D pixel-art platformer: a child explores a storybook Persian castle that has become a school-prison dungeon of locked cages, keys and stone wings. Mysterious and curious rather than scary, playful tension. Plucked tar and setar ostinato, soft daf frame drum pulse, low bowed kamancheh drone, distant santur glints, echoing stone-hall space. Medium-slow tempo around 90 BPM, steady pulse, minor Persian Shur colour. Consistent energy throughout with no big intro, breakdown or ending, so it loops cleanly. No vocals.

alternates.source/darkshang_theme_taiko_v1.mp3: Instrumental Persian chase music for a dark platformer pursuit, built around percussion. Lead percussion is a Persian tombak goblet drum played with fast virtuosic finger rolls, deep bass 'tom' strokes and sharp rim 'bak' clicks, answered by a darbuka (doumbek) playing a driving maqsum dum-tek-tek-dum-tek rhythm, with a large frame daf and riq jingles on the off-beats. Over the drums, a tense kamancheh spike fiddle and a breathy ney flute trade short ominous phrases in Persian dastgah Homayun with its augmented second, plucked tar ostinato underneath, a low drone. Urgent, relentless, dark and mysterious, around 120 BPM, consistent high intensity the whole way with no intro, no breakdown and no ending so it loops seamlessly. No Western orchestra, no taiko, no synths, no vocals.
alternates.source/darkshang_theme_darbuka.mp3: Instrumental Middle Eastern chase music for a dark platformer pursuit: a darbuka (doumbek) and a Persian tombak drive the whole piece with fast interlocking dum-tek-ka patterns and finger rolls in 6/8, a deep daf frame drum pulse, finger cymbals and riq accents. A low santur tremolo ostinato and a gritty tar riff in Persian Chahargah mode, with a mournful kamancheh and ney answering on top. Ominous, urgent, a shadow is chasing you through a moonlit city at night. Around 126 BPM, constant intensity from start to finish with no intro, breakdown or ending so it loops seamlessly. Acoustic instruments only: no taiko, no orchestral strings, no synths, no vocals.

layered version (bed + source/darkshang_.melody_prompt: Dark Persian melodic instrumental with absolutely no percussion and no drums of any kind: only melodic instruments. A hammered santur plays a fast nervous tremolo ostinato and a haunting repeating motif, a mournful kamancheh spike fiddle plays long ominous phrases, a breathy low ney flute answers it, a plucked oud adds a dark rhythmic ostinato, over a low sustained drone. layered version (bed + source/darkshang_.why: In play no melody could be heard in the drum-led take (measured ~43% percussive vs ~6% melodic energy), so a percussion-free melody stem is mixed in here at a set balance: final mix ~28% percussive, ~23% melodic, drums still on top.
